content.what_it_is: CUDA Fortran module boundary_condition_module (L1-L2065) for FUNWAVE-GPU: ghost-cell/boundary handling on device arrays. Contains (1) two attributes(global) kernels boundary_condition_X_kernel (L56/L58) and boundary_condition_Y_kernel (L107/L109) that zero fluxes P_d/Q_d/Fx_d/Fy_d/Gx_d/Gy_d at masked (MASK_d<1) cells and set wall hydrostatic flux 0.5_SP*GRAV*(EtaR*EtaR*Gamma3+2.0_SP*EtaR*Depth)*MASK at wet-dry faces (L79-81,L92-94,L127-129,L141-143), thread index j (or i) = threadIdx%x+(blockIdx%x-1)*BlockDimX_2D (L68,L117); (2) BOUNDARY_CONDITION_FLUXES_GPU (L152-330) which imposes the same wall-flux closure on the four domain edges via !$cuf kernels (west L158-195, east L197-230, south L239-272, north L273-304; COUPLING branches restrict to segments outside Kstart/Kend nesting windows; y-side skipped when CARTESIAN PERIODIC L232-237,L306-308), then launches both kernels with grid=dim3(ceiling(real(Nloc or Mloc)/BlockDimX_2D),1,1) (L311-327) and cudaDeviceSynchronize (L328); (3) EXCHANGE_DISPERSION_GPU (L340-447) calling PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU per dispersion array with VTYPE codes (1 symmetric both, 2 u-like x-mirror, 3 v-like y-mirror); under CARTESIAN it also exchanges time-derivative arrays when Gamma2>ZERO (L358-415: ETAT_d if DISP_TIME_LEFT else Ut_d..DVtxy_d, then Ux_d..ETAy_d), while the non-CARTESIAN branch (L417-444) has no Gamma2 block; (4) EXCHANGE_GPU (L459-526) exchanging Eta_d, MASK_d, U_d/HU_d/V_d/HV_d (plus AGE_BREAKING_d, nu_break_d, and P_d/Q_d via PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH_GPU when VISCOSITY_BREAKING/WAVEMAKER_VIS/DIFFUSION_SPONGE, L472-484) and then masking U,V,HU,HV by MASK_d in a 2D cuf kernel (L514-521); (5) PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH_GPU (L536-613): mirror-fill of the 4 ghost bands for staggered-size arrays, MGPU sides applied only where neighbor .eq. MPI_PROC_NULL; (6) PHI_COLL_GPU (L627-1251): ghost fill dispatch on VTYPE 1-6 (1 eta symmetric; 2 u x-antisymmetric/y-symmetric; 3 v x-symmetric/y-antisymmetric; 4 cross-derivative zeroing 0.0_SP; 5 symmetric; 6 anti-symmetric), with CARTESIAN PERIODIC y-wrap done first: MGPU PY>1 path uses cudaMemcpy2D staging into host arrays send2d/xx and MPI_SENDRECV between ProcessorID(II,1) and ProcessorID(II,PY) (L651-674), PY=1 path uses two device cudaMemcpy2D (L687-693), serial path a cuf kernel wrap (L698-704); MGPU final halo update via phi_exch_cuda (L1248); (7) PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU (L1255-1876): same structure/VTYPE 1-6 as PHI_COLL_GPU but without the phi_exch_cuda call at the end; (8) PHI_COLL_INT_GPU (L1880-2064): INTEGER PHI variant (used for MASK via generic interface PHI_COLL_GPU L37-40), only VTYPE==1 implemented (L1965-2058), MPI_SENDRECV with MPI_INTEGER (L1916,L1923), device-to-device cudaMemcpy2D with explicit cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice flag (L1942-1945), phi_exch_cuda at L2061. West-side ghost fill is skipped everywhere when WaveMaker(1:11)=='LEFT_BC_IRR' (e.g. L180,L547,L726,L821,L916,L1975). Data blocks: none (source code file).

unresolved: L213 references Gamma3_d in the COUPLING east-edge second loop while the parallel first loop L206 uses Gamma3; Gamma3_d is not in any use list of this module (L2-34) nor declared locally -> undefined symbol when COUPLING is defined; relation L206 vs L213.

PHI_COLL_OUTER_GPU ends at L1876 without the MGPU 'call phi_exch_cuda' that PHI_COLL_GPU (L1248) and PHI_COLL_INT_GPU (L2061) have -> under MGPU the dispersion arrays exchanged via EXCHANGE_DISPERSION_GPU (L346-444) receive no inter-rank halo update on non-periodic sides; relation L1245-1251 vs L1873-1876.

EXCHANGE_DISPERSION_GPU: the IF(Gamma2>ZERO) time-derivative exchange block (L358-415) exists only in the CARTESIAN branch; the non-CARTESIAN branch L417-444 omits ETAT_d/Ut_d..DVtxy_d entirely; relation L344 vs L416.

boundary_condition_Y_kernel declares integer,value :: n_suth,n_nrth unconditionally at L113 (not MGPU-guarded, unlike X kernel L62-64), but the serial signature L109 does not pass them -> in a non-MGPU build they are non-dummy locals carrying the VALUE attribute; referenced only inside MGPU blocks L123,L137.

MPI symbols MPI_PROC_NULL (L75 etc.), MPI_STATUS_SIZE (L642,L1270,L1896), MPI_SP (L661), MPI_INTEGER (L1916), MPI_COMM_WORLD (L662) are not use-associated in this file; presumably provided by PARAM (L4) or mgpu_utilities (L22) in MGPU builds -- not resolvable from this file.
PHI_COLL_INT_GPU declares INTEGER,DIMENSION(1) :: req at L1894 but req is never used in the subroutine body (L1899-2063).

L491 passes MASK_d to generic PHI_COLL_GPU with PERIODIC; commented-out code L487-490 shows a prior rMASK REAL copy approach and a commented PHI_COLL_INT_GPU call; which specific procedure the generic resolves to depends on MASK_d's declared type in mod_cuda (not visible here); relation L37-40 vs L487-491.
Renamed imports n_left/n_right/n_bottom/n_top (L32) are never referenced in this file; MGPU neighbor tests use n_west/n_east/n_suth/n_nrth from GLOBAL (L19).

MGPU periodic staging arrays xx,send2d (L643,L1271,L1897) are host arrays used directly as cudaMemcpy2D source/target and MPI buffers; whether MPI_SENDRECV on them overlaps correctly with device sync is not determinable from this file.
